papers.title_en: The Society of Thoracic Surgeons 2026 Long-term Risk Models for Lung Cancer Resection.
papers.authors: Feczko A, Abdelsattar ZM, Bonnell L, Chang SC, Khullar OV, Ravanbakhsh S, Habib RH, Seder CW et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic and Cardiovascular Surgery, Heart, Vascular and Thoracic Institute, Cleveland Clinic Foundation, …
papers.results: 7.0%患者发生术后并发症；中位随访3.9年（95%CI 3.8-4.0），期间死亡28,903例（25.6%）；腺癌占66.0%，I期占68.8%。乐观校正（bootstrap-adjusted）C-index：有重大并发症者0.71（95%CI 0.70-0.71），无重大并发症者0.72（95%CI 0.71-0.73）；30%验证集中总体及预设亚组校准曲线目视评估为优秀。主要终点为7年截尾死亡率（届时仍有>12%处于风险集中）。
papers.authors_conclusion: The STS now offers thoracic surgeons short- and long-term models for self-evaluation, quality improvement, and research. Development of public facing risk calculators will operationalize this novel resource.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足之处：摘要未报告任何预测变量的效应量（HR/CI）、未给出校准的定量指标（仅称目视评估优秀）、未与TNM分期或既有生存工具做增量价值比较；模型仅有同一数据库内的70/30拆分验证，无外部队列外部验证，泛化性存疑。所谓long-term实际中位随访3.9年、7年截尾时>12%仍在风险集中，远期预测可靠性受限。区分度0.71-0.72属中等，作者结论强调资源可用性与计算器落地，未提示上述局限。

pico.p: 2015-2023年STS普通胸外科数据库中362家参与医院接受根治意图肺切除的原发性肺癌成年患者112,756例（70%开发集/30%验证集）
pico.ic: 无干预对照；按有无重大术后并发症分层建立独立的多变量Cox模型并以拆分验证集比较预测与观察生存（校准）

papers.reason: 为肺癌切除术后长期生存预测提供可照搬的建模框架与基线区分度参照（C-index约0.71-0.72），影响术后随访强度分层与患者沟通工具选择，也可作为同类预后模型研究的性能对照基线。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The Society of Thoracic Surgeons (STS) has designed and validated risk models to predict long-term survival in patients undergoing lung cancer resection. METHODS: Adult patients undergoing curative intent lung resection for primary lung cancer in the STS General Thoracic Surgery Database (2015-2023) were included. Vital status was ascertained through linkage to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention National Death Index and Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services inpatient records. The primary endpoint was mortality, truncated at 7 years with >12% remaining at risk. 70% derivation and 30% validation subgroups were utilized. Individualized survival prediction risk scores were derived using separate stratified multivariable Cox proportional hazards models for patients with and without major postoperative complications. Model discrimination was quantified by bootstrap-adjusted Harrel's C-index. Calibration was assessed visually comparing predicted and observed survival curves. RESULTS: The study included 112,756 patients across 362 STS participant hospitals, of whom 7.0% experienced a postoperative complication. Median follow-up was 3.9 years (95% CI, 3.8-4.0), during which 28,903 deaths (25.6%) occurred. Adenocarcinoma (66.0%) and stage I disease were most prevalent (68.8%). The optimism-adjusted C-index for the risk models were good for patients with [0.71 (95% CI, 0.70-0.71)] and without major complications [0.72 (0.71-0.73)]. Calibration of the model was excellent overall and in prespecified subgroups in the 30% validation set. CONCLUSIONS: The STS now offers thoracic surgeons short- and long-term models for self-evaluation, quality improvement, and research. Development of public facing risk calculators will operationalize this novel resource.

papers.title_zh: 基于外周血单个核细胞DNA甲基化的食管鳞癌内镜前风险分层工具：两阶段多中心开发验证及前瞻性队列评价
papers.title_en: A peripheral blood mononuclear cell DNA methylation-based risk stratification tool for esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
papers.authors: Li P, Xie Y, Zhao Y, Qi Q, Zhang S, Zhang Z, Gao C, Liu K et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Clinical Laboratory, The Second Qilu Hospital of Shandong University, Jinan, Shandong 250033, China.
papers.results: AUC：训练集0.987，测试集0.966，验证集0.943；前瞻性多中心队列中按预设cutoff将人群分为低/高风险组，仅对高风险者行内镜可将每例检出所需内镜数从25.02降至4.78，避免83%不必要内镜，同时保留>90%检出敏感度；摘要未报告各AUC的95%CI及前瞻性队列的AUC/敏感度/特异度具体数值
papers.authors_conclusion: These findings establish ESCCseeker as a reliable pre-endoscopic triage tool that minimizes unnecessary invasive procedures and prioritizes high-risk individuals.
papers.ai_note: ① 模型并非纯甲基化工具，整合了SCC-Ag与CYFRA21-1等常规标志物，摘要未报告甲基化特征相对于常规标志物的增量价值（如单独甲基化模型的AUC或联合模型的净重分类改善），'outperforming conventional biomarkers'的比较对象和增量幅度信息不足；② AUC 0.987/0.966/0.943均无95%CI，且训练/测试/验证队列的划分细节与样本量均未在摘要中给出，存在过拟合与选择偏倚无法评估的问题；③ 前瞻性队列仅报告内镜数减少与'>90%检出敏感度'的模糊表述，未给出精确敏感度、特异度、阳性/阴性预测值及其CI，亦未报告前瞻性队列自身的AUC；④ 83%不必要内镜的避免比例高度依赖于研究人群的癌症患病率（低患病率人群NNE改善会更显著），该数值的外推性存疑。

pico.p: 两阶段多中心研究人群（开发、测试、验证队列）及前瞻性多中心队列；各队列具体样本量摘要未报告
pico.ic: PBMC DNA甲基化8个差异甲基化位点+年龄+性别+SCC-Ag+CYFRA21-1的机器学习模型（ESCCseeker），以预设cutoff进行内镜前风险分层；对照为常规生物标志物（SCC-Ag、CYFRA21-1）及全部行内镜策略

papers.reason: 为食管鳞癌高危人群的内镜前分层提供了一种微创血液甲基化工具的多中心验证数据，直接影响人群筛查中内镜资源分配策略与低风险者是否可安全豁免内镜的临床决策；同时其联合常规标志物的建模方式为后续ESCC液体活检标志物研究提供方法学参考基线。
papers.abstract_en: Early detection of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma is essential for improving survival, but reliance on endoscopy limits feasibility for population-wide screening. We developed ESCCseeker, a minimally invasive risk stratification tool based on peripheral blood mononuclear cells' DNA methylation. In a two-stage multicenter study in China, genome-wide profiling identifies distinct methylation markers between ESCC patients and controls. In the development and verification cohort, machine learning yields a model integrating eight differentially methylated positions with age, gender, SCC-Ag, and CYFRA21-1. ESCCseeker demonstrates robust performance (AUC: 0.987 training, 0.966 test, 0.943 verification), outperforming conventional biomarkers. In a prospective multicenter cohort, the predefined cutoff stratifies individuals into low- and high-risk groups. Restricting endoscopy to high-risk individuals reduces the number of endoscopies needed from 25.02 to 4.78, avoiding 83% of unnecessary procedures while preserving >90% detection sensitivity. These findings establish ESCCseeker as a reliable pre-endoscopic triage tool that minimizes unnecessary invasive procedures and prioritizes high-risk individuals. This trial was registered with the Chinese Clinical Trial Registry (ChiCTR2500095967).

papers.title_zh: IV期食管癌食管切除术生存获益的荟萃分析：单臂汇总3年OS较高但比较性证据HR无显著性
papers.title_en: A Meta-Analysis of the Role of Esophagectomy in Stage 4 Esophageal Cancer.
papers.authors: Zheng N, Sewell DB, Chen S, Molena D
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Surgery, SUNY Downstate Health Sciences University, New York, NY; Thoracic Service, Department of Surgery,…
papers.results: 自手术起算的汇总3年OS为43%（95%CI, 22%-67%）；自诊断或治疗启动起算的汇总3年OS为61%（95%CI, 23%-89%）；异质性显著（I2>80%）。排除胃癌研究后的2项比较性研究汇总HR为0.16（95%CI, 0.00-6.19），差异无统计学意义；纳入胃癌研究的敏感性分析汇总HR为0.25（95%CI, 0.03-2.02）。有利预后因素包括R0切除、ypM0状态、较低淋巴结负荷、对系统治疗有反应及寡转移疾病。
papers.authors_conclusion: 在高度选择的IV期食管癌患者中，尤其是寡转移且对系统治疗反应良好者，食管切除术可被纳入多模态治疗策略中考虑；这些发现支持生物学驱动、反应适应的转换手术方式；仍需前瞻性研究界定其作用。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足/方法学疑点：(1) 汇总OS主要来自单臂手术队列，缺乏对照，存在明显的选择偏倚与保证时间偏倚，无法据此推断手术带来生存获益；(2) 唯一的比较性证据（HR 0.16, 95%CI 0.00-6.19）CI跨越1且极宽，无统计学显著性，但作者结论仍正面支持转换手术，属选择性强调；(3) 以诊断/治疗启动起算的3年OS（61%）高于自手术起算（43%），该方向与起点偏倚的常见预期不一致，且CI 23%-89%极宽，解读价值有限；(4) I2>80%的高异质性下仍给出汇总点估计；(5) 有利预后因素的列举未给出相应效应量与统计检验。

pico.ic: 食管切除术（手术 vs 非手术/内科治疗，仅2项比较性研究提供HR）

papers.reason: 影响IV期/寡转移食管癌转换手术的患者筛选与多模态治疗决策，同时提示当前支持证据主要为低等级单臂数据，为开展前瞻性对照研究提供基线参照
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Nearly 40% of new cases of esophageal cancer are diagnosed at stage 4. Esophagectomy may offer a survival benefit in highly selected patients with stage 4 esophageal cancer. METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted in accordance with PRISMA guidelines. Databases including PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched. Studies reporting survival outcomes in patients with stage 4 esophageal cancer undergoing surgical resection were included. Random-effects models were used to pool 3-year overall survival (OS) and hazard ratios (HRs). Subgroup analyses were performed based on the timing of survival measurement (diagnosis vs. surgery). RESULTS: Eleven studies comprising 608 surgical patients were included. The pooled 3-year OS was 43% (95% confidence interval {CI}, 22%-67%) when measured from surgery and 61% (95% CI, 23%-89%) when measured from diagnosis or treatment initiation, with substantial heterogeneity (I2>80%). Pooled HR analysis of the 2 comparative studies without gastric cancer showed better survival with surgery, although the difference was not significant (HR, 0.16 [95% CI, 0.00-6.19]); a sensitivity analysis with the gastric cancer study yielded a similar estimate (HR, 0.25 [95% CI, 0.03-2.02]). Favorable prognostic factors included R0 resection, ypM0 status, lower nodal burden, response to systemic therapy, and oligometastatic disease. CONCLUSIONS: In highly selected patients with stage IV esophageal cancer, particularly those with oligometastatic disease and favorable response to systemic therapy, esophagectomy may be considered within a multimodal treatment strategy. These findings support a biologically driven, response-adapted approach to conversion surgery. Prospective studies are required to define its role.

papers.abstract_en: Selective RET inhibitors have transformed the treatment landscape of RET fusion-positive non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), yet durable systemic and intracranial disease control remains a major clinical challenge. We conducted a multicenter, single-arm phase 2 study of soxataltinib, a highly selective CNS-penetrant RET inhibitor, in treatment-naïve (n=56) and previously treated patients (n=49) with advanced RET fusion-positive NSCLC. At a median follow-up of 19.3 months, the independent review committee (IRC)-assessed ORR was 84.8% (95% CI, 76.4-91.0), including 89.3% in treatment-naïve and 79.6% in previously treated patients. Responses were observed across clinically relevant subgroups, including patients with baseline brain metastases. Median progression-free survival (PFS) was not reached in the overall population. Intracranial response was observed in patients with measurable CNS disease [ intracranial ORRs were 100% (4/4) in treatment-naïve and 60.0% (3/5) in previously treated patients], supporting clinically meaningful CNS control. Grade ≥3 TRAEs occurred in 76.2% of patients and were generally manageable with dose modification; treatment discontinuation due to adverse events occurred in 1.9%, with no treatment-related deaths. Soxataltinib demonstrated durable systemic and intracranial antitumor activity in RET fusion-positive NSCLC, supporting its further development as a next-generation RET-targeted therapy.

papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: Dosage modifications, including dose interruptions and reductions, are commonly implemented to manage adverse reactions observed with oncology drugs. However, their impact on efficacy is not well understood. Here, we explored the impact of dosage modifications on progression free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS) for four US FDA-approved tyrosine kinase inhibitors for the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) mutations. METHODS: We collected patient-level data from clinical trials supporting the original FDA approvals of afatinib, dacomitinib, mobocertinib, and osimertinib. We identified the daily dose received (DDR; a measure of the dosage received by a patient each day), dose interruptions and reductions over the treatment period. In this exploratory analysis, we used a time-dependent Cox proportional hazards model to assess the impact of DDR on PFS and landmark time-fixed Cox models at 30, 60, and 90 days from treatment initiation to assess the impact of early dose interruptions and reductions on PFS and OS. RESULTS: While the impact of dose interruptions and reductions on the risk of death varied among the studied drugs, dose interruptions, such as interruptions for four or more consecutive days, were more often associated with a higher risk of progression or death than dose reductions. CONCLUSION: For the evaluated drugs as monotherapy in NSCLC with EGFR mutations, our analysis suggests that dose reductions might have a lower impact on efficacy than missing or interrupting treatment. Further studies are needed to evaluate other EGFR treatments, drug classes, and cancer types.

papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: To compare the diagnostic performance and complication profiles of CT-guided core-needle biopsy (CNB) and fine-needle aspiration (FNA) for pulmonary ground-glass nodules (GGNs). METHODS: Consecutive patients who underwent CT-guided percutaneous biopsy of pulmonary GGNs between January 2021 and August 2022 were screened. Of 657 patients assessed, 538 were included (CNB, n = 448; FNA, n = 90). Six FNA results classified as atypical cells were considered indeterminate and excluded from binary diagnostic-performance analyses, leaving 532 classifiable cases. Final diagnoses were established by surgical pathology or imaging follow-up of at least 12 months. Diagnostic performance was compared without adjustment, whereas complication outcomes were assessed using multivariable logistic regression and inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW). RESULTS: Among the 532 classifiable biopsies, the overall accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity were 93.2%, 91.4%, and 100.0%, respectively, based on the available composite reference standard. CNB showed higher unadjusted accuracy than FNA (94.6% vs. 85.7%, P = 0.007) and higher sensitivity (93.2% vs. 82.4%, P = 0.008). In the full cohort of 538 procedures, multivariable analysis showed that CNB was associated with higher odds of intrapulmonary hemorrhage (adjusted odds ratio [aOR]: 2.91; P < 0.001) and hemoptysis (aOR: 3.07; P < 0.001), whereas no statistically significant association was observed for pneumothorax. CONCLUSION: CT-guided percutaneous biopsy yielded determinate diagnostic results for most pulmonary GGNs under the available composite reference standard. In unadjusted comparisons, CNB showed higher diagnostic accuracy and sensitivity than FNA but was associated with greater risks of hemorrhagic complications. Given the lack of adjustment for baseline differences in diagnostic-performance analyses, the apparent diagnostic advantage of CNB should be interpreted cautiously. Biopsy technique should be individualized according to lesion characteristics and patient-specific risks.

papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: Nivolumab plus ipilimumab is a standard first-line therapy for unresectable malignant pleural mesothelioma (MPM), yet biomarkers predicting immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) efficacy remain undefined. We aimed to identify genomic and tumor immune microenvironmental features associated with ICI response in MPM. EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN: We analyzed two independent MPM cohorts. The discovery cohort included patients at the National Cancer Center Hospital (2012-2022) with frozen tumor tissues available for whole-genome sequencing (WGS) and RNA sequencing. Genomic alterations, transcriptomic profiles, immune cell composition, and T-cell receptor repertoire were analyzed, and key findings were validated in a nationwide Center for Cancer Genomics and Advanced Therapeutics (C-CAT) cohort. RESULTS: The WGS cohort comprised 52 patients. Among ICI-treated patients, overall response rates were 30% in the WGS cohort and 29.4% in the C-CAT cohort. Genomic analyses identified frequent alterations in BAP1 and NF2, across both cohorts. ICI responders showed higher T-cell receptor diversity, increased CD8⁺ T-cell infiltration, and enrichment of M1 macrophages compared with non-responders. MTAP loss was associated with higher CD8⁺ T-cell infiltration and T-cell receptor diversity, and was linked to a higher ICI response rate in the C-CAT cohort. In contrast, BAP1 and NF2 alterations showed no consistent association with immune features or ICI efficacy. CONCLUSIONS: An immune-active tumor microenvironment characterized by high T-cell receptor diversity, CD8⁺ T-cell infiltration, and M1 macrophage enrichment was associated with favorable ICI responses in MPM. MTAP loss was linked to immune-related features and a higher ICI response, supporting further investigation of MTAP loss as a candidate biomarker.

papers.abstract_en: RATIONALE: The ability to predict progression from a pre-disease state in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), pre-COPD, to overt COPD remains limited. OBJECTIVE: To test the hypothesis that development of COPD can be predicted by characterizing pre-COPD and creating a simple pre-COPD score. METHODS: We identified individuals without airflow obstruction, defined as pre-bronchodilator (BD) forced expiratory volume in 1 second (FEV1)/forced vital capacity (FVC)≥0.70 and ≥lower limit of normal, from the Copenhagen General Population Study (CGPS)(N = 14,506), Copenhagen City Heart Study (CCHS)(N = 8673), and Genetic Epidemiology for COPD (COPDGene) Study(N = 2982). A pre-COPD score was developed in CGPS by assigning 1 point to each of smoking history≥10 pack-years, active smoking, any respiratory symptom, asthma, and pre-BD FEV1/FVC 0.70-0.75, and 4 points for pre-BD FEV1<80% predicted, indicating presence of Preserved Ratio Impaired Spirometry (PRISm), with external validation in CCHS and COPDGene. Participants were followed for 5-10 years for incident COPD, defined as pre-BD FEV1/FVC<0.70 and FEV1<80% predicted. MEASUREMENTS AND MAIN RESULTS: During follow-up, COPD developed in 669 individuals (4.6%) in CGPS, 685 (7.9%) in CCHS, and 367 (12%) in COPDGene. In CGPS, 10-year incidence was 1.5% in the low-risk, 9.3% in the intermediate-risk, 24% in the high-risk, and 42% in the very high-risk category. Corresponding 5-year incidences were 3.7%, 7.3%, 12%, and 25% in CCHS, and 4.1%, 5.3%, 13%, and 31% in COPDGene, respectively. The pre-COPD score demonstrated good discrimination with areas under curve of 0.88 in CGPS, 0.76 in CCHS, and 0.81 in COPDGene. The pre-COPD score was also associated with exacerbations. CONCLUSIONS: The pre-COPD score is useful in predicting the onset of COPD with clinically relevant discrimination in three cohorts with different risk profiles.

papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: Lung cancer screening guidelines generally recommend imaging surveillance rather than tissue sampling for nodules measuring ≤8 mm. Evidence regarding the feasibility, diagnostic performance, and safety of tissue biopsy in this lesion size remains limited. We evaluated the diagnostic performance and safety of shape-sensing robotic-assisted bronchoscopy (ssRAB) for biopsy of peripheral pulmonary nodules measuring ≤8 mm. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective single-center study of consecutive patients who underwent ssRAB between June 2020 and December 2025 for biopsy of nodules measuring ≤8 mm on pre-procedural CT imaging. The primary outcome was strict diagnostic yield, as defined by the American Thoracic Society/American College of Chest Physicians. Secondary objectives included intermediate diagnostic yield, diagnostic distribution, procedural outcomes, and complications. Diagnostic performance according to lesion size (≤ 6 mm vs. 6.1-8 mm) was evaluated separately as a subgroup analysis. RESULTS: A total of 195 nodules were included in the study. Median lesions diameter was seven mm (IQR 6-8). Strict diagnostic yield was 70.2% (137/195), while intermediate diagnostic yield was 77.4% (151/195). Malignancy was identified in 104 lesions (53.3%). The median ssRAB procedure time was 59 min (IQR 45-83). Pneumothorax occurred in six patients (3.3%), with chest tube placement required in two (1.1%). DISCUSSION: Shape-sensing robotic-assisted bronchoscopy demonstrated meaningful diagnostic performance and a favorable safety profile for peripheral pulmonary nodules measuring ≤8 mm, including lesions ≤6 mm. In this selected, higher-risk cohort, our findings suggest that earlier tissue diagnosis can be feasible and may benefit some patients.

papers.abstract_en: The Global Initiative for Asthma (GINA) Strategy Report provides a comprehensive, annually updated evidence-based approach to asthma diagnosis, assessment, treatment, and prevention across the lifespan. Its central approach is personalized, iterative care based on the Assess-Adjust-Review cycle for both symptom control and reduction of future risk (including severe exacerbations, persistent airflow limitation, and treatment-related harm).GINA emphasizes objective confirmation of diagnosis wherever possible, and regular assessment of lung function, inhaler technique, adherence, multimorbidity, risk factors (including Type-2 biomarkers), and patient goals and preferences. GINA strongly recommends that all adults, adolescents, children and most preschoolers with asthma should receive inhaled corticosteroid (ICS)-containing treatment. GINA recommends against short-acting beta2-agonist (SABA)-only treatment. For adults/adolescents, GINA Track 1 using low-dose ICS-formoterol, an anti-inflammatory reliever (AIR), either as-needed-only (AIR-only) or as maintenance-and-reliever therapy (MART), is preferred because of its substantial reduction in severe exacerbations compared with SABA-based regimens, and its simplicity. Age-specific treatment pathways in children also emphasize ICS-containing therapy and exacerbation prevention.For difficult-to-treat and severe asthma, GINA provides structured guidance, emphasizing diagnostic verification, optimization of modifiable factors, inflammatory phenotyping, biologic therapy selection, and (as for all patients) systemic corticosteroid stewardship. Acute exacerbation care incorporates long-term preventive treatment, including post-discharge reassessment of management and action plan.Key 2026 updates include expanded AIR options for adults and children, revised guidance on severe asthma and selection of biologic treatment, and substantial updates to acute asthma management.GINA integrates evidence-based management with shared decision-making, self-management education, implementation, and global advocacy to reduce preventable asthma morbidity and mortality.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Undernutrition is the leading driver of tuberculosis worldwide, yet its effect on the lungs of people who complete treatment is not well defined. RESEARCH QUESTION: Among adults treated for drug-sensitive pulmonary tuberculosis, is undernutrition associated with worse post-treatment lung function, radiographic severity, exercise capacity and respiratory quality of life, and does systemic inflammation mediate that association? STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: Adults (≥18 years) with drug-sensitive pulmonary tuberculosis were enrolled at treatment initiation in India. We measured associations of baseline body mass index (BMI), mid-upper arm circumference (MUAC), and premorbid BMI with spirometry, chest radiograph score, six-minute walk distance and St George's Respiratory Questionnaire score. Plasma IFN-γ, TNF-α and IL-6 were measured at baseline and month 2; counterfactual mediation analysis partitioned the effect of undernutrition on lung function into direct and inflammation-mediated components. RESULTS: Of 156 participants analyzed, 76 (48.7%) had a ventilatory defect; 52 (33.3%) had airflow obstruction and 31 (19.9%) had restrictive spirometry. Each 1 kg/m2 higher baseline BMI was associated with lower odds of any ventilatory defect (adjusted odds ratio [aOR], 0.78; 95% CI, 0.67-0.90), and BMI below 16 kg/m2 carried five-fold higher odds than BMI ≥18.5 kg/m2 (aOR, 5.08; 95% CI, 1.76-16.02). MUAC and premorbid BMI showed similar associations. Lower BMI was associated with restrictive spirometry (aOR, 0.74 per kg/m2; 95% CI, 0.59-0.89) but not airflow obstruction (aOR, 0.91; 95% CI, 0.80-1.03). Undernourished participants had higher baseline IL-6, which mediated 32% (FEV1) and 49% (FVC) of the association with impaired lung function. INTERPRETATION: Undernutrition before and at treatment initiation is a potentially modifiable determinant of post-treatment lung impairment, with systemic inflammation mediating part of the effect. Nutritional assessment belongs in routine tuberculosis care, and nutritional support should be tested to prevent lung-function impairment in tuberculosis survivors.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Most patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) do not receive maintenance inhaled therapies in concordance with evidence-based clinical guidelines. Long-acting muscarinic antagonists (LAMA), the recommended first-line therapy, is underused, while inhaled corticosteroids (ICS)/long-acting beta-agonists (LABA) are often used in discordance with clinical guidelines. In July 2020, British Columbia's (BC) universal drug plan removed prior authorization requirements for coverage for LAMA medications and restricted coverage for ICS/LABA. RESEARCH QUESTION: What is the impact of this policy change on guideline-concordant maintenance inhaled medication use? STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: In a population-based cohort study using provincial administrative health data, we identified patients with COPD using a validated case definition and followed them from January 2019 (18 months pre-policy) to December 2022 (30 months post-policy). Using interrupted time series analysis, we evaluated the monthly proportion of patients filling a prescription for ICS/LABA and LAMA, mean canisters dispensed, proportion of days covered (PDC), rates of ICS/LABA discontinuation, LAMA (re)initiation, and initiating LAMA as first maintenance therapy. We report absolute differences between observed and counterfactual outcomes at study end. RESULTS: The cohort included 47,583 patients with COPD (mean 71.5 years, 46.5% female, 31.7 months mean follow-up). Thirty months post-policy change, ICS/LABA use decreased by -1.3% (95% CI -2.4, -0.3) and LAMA use increased by 0.8% (95% CI 0.1, 1.6). There was no significant change in the number of ICS/LABA canisters dispensed, PDC or proportion discontinuing ICS/LABA. Mean LAMA canisters dispensed increased by 9.8 per 1,000 patients (95% CI 1.0, 18.7) and PDC increased by 1.5% (95% CI 0.5, 2.4). (Re)initiation of LAMA or initiating LAMA as maintenance therapy increased by 0.2% (95% CI 0.02, 0.3) and 34.8% (95% CI 22.3, 48.6), respectively. Total combined drug costs did not change. INTERPRETATION: Changes to drug coverage in BC were associated with improved guideline-concordant medication use.

papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVE: To develop DCE-MRI parameters based logistic regression models to evaluate microvascular heterogeneity between esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) and cephalic peritumoral esophageal segmental tissues. METHODS: 133 consecutive ESCC patients receiving preoperative DCE-MRI from two centers were randomly divided into the training, internal validation and external validation cohorts at a ratio of 8:2:2. Mean, standard deviation (SD), coefficient of variation (CV) of DCE-MRI derived reflux rate (Kep), endothelial transfer constant (Ktrans) and fractional extravascular extracellular space volume (Ve) were compared between tumor (T) and five cephalic peritumoral esophageal segmental tissues at incremental 1-5 cm (recorded as PT1-PT5), and the statistical differential parameters were selected to develop logistic regression models to improve assessment of microvascular heterogeneity between ESCC and cephalic peritumoral esophageal segmental tissues. Model's performance was evaluated using area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) with DeLong's test. RESULTS: All parameters showed differences among T, PT1, PT2 and PT3 except among PT3-PT5. Ve_CV and Kep_mean showed discriminatory ability among T, PT1, PT2 and PT3-5 (P-values < 0.05). Multivariate models by combining Ve_CV and Kep_mean outperformed Ve_CV or Kep_mean to show microvascular heterogeneity in T vs. PT2 (model AUC: 0.830, 0.917, and 0.818), and in T vs. PT3-5 (model AUC: 0.921, 0.845, and 0.857), while Ve_CV outperformed model for T vs. PT1 or Kep_mean (Ve_CV AUC: 0.716, 0.872, and 0.787) in the training, internal and external validation cohorts, respectively (P-values < 0.05). CONCLUSION: Our multivariate models help discriminate ESCC vs. PT2 or PT3-5 whereas Ve_CV can discriminate ESCC vs. PT1. ADVANCES IN KNOWLEDGE: In this study on DCE-MRI, after consolidating peritumoral tissues with 3-5 cm from the cephalic tumor margin of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma into a single group due to no significant differences among them, significant differences were identified among the tumor, peritumoral tissues 1 cm, 2 cm, and 3-5 cm from the margin, reflecting progressive microvascular heterogeneity with the incremental distances. Model by combination of mean reflux rate and coefficient of variation of fractional extravascular extracellular space volume (Ve_CV) help discriminate microvascular heterogeneity between tumor and cephalic peritumoral tissues except that Ve_CV help discriminate tumor vs. 1 cm from the tumor margin.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Pulmonary embolism (PE) in patients with pneumonia presents a major diagnostic challenge because of overlapping clinical features and the limited specificity of conventional tools. Machine learning (ML)-based models have been proposed to improve diagnostic accuracy by integrating clinical, laboratory, and imaging data. METHODS: Five databases were searched from inception to May 2026. Fifteen studies met inclusion criteria, of which ten provided sufficient data for quantitative synthesis. The primary meta-analysis was restricted to studies reporting patient- or examination-level binary PE detection against an imaging or adjudicated reference standard; clinical prediction, segmentation/localization, thrombosis, and mortality outcomes were analyzed separately, and overlapping public-dataset studies were reduced to one estimate per dataset. Pooled sensitivity, specificity, and summary receiver operating characteristic estimates were calculated using a bivariate random-effects model. Between-study heterogeneity was assessed using the I² statistic. Meta-regression and subgroup analyses explored sources of heterogeneity. Study quality was evaluated using the PROBAST + AI tool, and certainty of evidence was assessed using the GRADE framework. RESULTS: Across included studies, ML-based models showed high overall diagnostic discrimination for PE detection in pneumonia. The primary analysis of six patient/examination-level studies yielded a pooled sensitivity of 0.91 (95% CI 0.76-0.97; 95% prediction interval 0.16-0.99), specificity of 0.92 (95% CI 0.68-0.98; 95% prediction interval 0.02-1.00), and a summary AUROC of 0.96 (95% CI 0.94-0.98). However, substantial heterogeneity (I2 = 77.8% overall; sensitivity I² = 76.0%, specificity I² = 85.3%) was observed across pooled estimates. Image-based deep-learning models applied to CTPA generally showed higher accuracy than clinical or hybrid approaches. According to GRADE, the overall certainty of evidence was rated as very low. Prediction intervals were wide, and the pooled operating point should not be read as the expected performance of a deployable model. Differences by reference standard and clinical setting were examined descriptively and are hypothesis-generating only. CONCLUSIONS: ML-based models show promise as adjunctive tools for PE detection in pneumonia, but current evidence is limited by heterogeneity and low certainty. Prospective, multicenter validation and standardized evaluation are required before clinical implementation. The current evidence is heterogeneous, indirect, and insufficient to establish the performance of a deployable tool in any individual clinical setting.

Despite substantial progress with EGFR-TKIs, the development of acquired resistance remains a major clinical challenge. Notably, the addition of immune checkpoint blockade after TKI resistance has not resulted in significant survival benefits compared to chemotherapy. In this study, we performed a comprehensive transcriptomic analysis of established osimertinib-resistant tumor models and found that the expression of the ectonucleotide phosphodiesterase ENPP1, a key regulator of extracellular cGAMP signaling, was significantly upregulated in resistant tumors compared to the parental TKI-sensitive NSCLC tumors. Genetic depletion or pharmacological inhibition of ENPP1 enhanced immune cell-mediated cytotoxicity against TKI-resistant tumor cells. Furthermore, the use of ENPP1 inhibitors both in vitro and in vivo enhanced immune cell activity and antitumor efficacy in TKI-resistant lung cancers with high ENPP1 expression. Importantly, these observations were further validated by paired clinical tumor samples, which demonstrated increased ENPP1 expression following the development of acquired EGFR-TKI resistance. Collectively, our study highlights a critical role for ENPP1 in mediating immune evasion through suppression of the cGAMP-STING pathway in the tumor immune microenvironment, supporting ENPP1 as a promising therapeutic target to enhance immunotherapy efficacy in EGFR-TKI-resistant NSCLC.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Adverse events (AEs) are routinely reported in placebo arms of lung cancer trials, yet these data have seldom been systematically synthesized. This meta-analysis aimed to quantify the incidence of AEs in placebo arms of phase III randomized controlled trials (RCTs) for non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and small cell lung cancer (SCLC). METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed, Embase, Ovid Medline, and Cochrane Library for phase III RCTs evaluating targeted therapy and/or immunotherapy in NSCLC or SCLC that included a placebo arm. Pooled incidence was estimated using random-effects models for any-grade and grade 3 or 4 AEs, treatment modifications (interruption, dose reduction, or discontinuation) due to AEs, and common AEs. RESULTS: Twenty-six RCTs comprising 7641 placebo-treated patients were included. The pooled incidence of any-grade AEs was 84% (95%CI: 78-90%, 95%PI: 54-100%), with grade 3 or 4 AEs occurring in 25% (95%CI: 19-32%, 95%PI: 4-57%). The most frequent any-grade AEs were fatigue (20%), dyspnea (20%), and cough (20%). Grade 3 or 4 AEs most commonly included fatigue (4%), dyspnea (3%), pneumonia (2%), and hypertension (2%). Treatment interruption or dose reduction due to AEs occurred in 10% (95%CI: 6-15%, 95%PI: 0-36%), and discontinuation in 5% (95%CI: 4-8%, 95%PI: 0-17%). CONCLUSION: Placebo-treated patients with lung cancer experience substantial AE burden, may attributable to disease itself and its prior treatment. The scarcity of nocebo-related data underscores the urgent need for future studies to investigate its mechanisms and systematically assess negative expectancy in patients.

Noninvasive preoperative stratification tools are urgently needed. METHODS: We retrospectively enrolled 129 NSCLC patients to develop and internally validate a combined model integrating clinical features, conventional CT findings, and dual-layer spectral CT parameters for predicting classic EGFR-activating mutations. Performance was evaluated by ROC, DeLong test, DCA, and 1000-iteration bootstrap validation. RESULTS: The combined model achieved an AUC of 0.805, significantly outperforming the clinical-conventional CT model (AUC = 0.642, P < 0.001). The model showed robust performance in the lung adenocarcinoma subgroup (AUC = 0.810) with negligible overfitting. CONCLUSIONS: This noninvasive spectral CT model provides a reliable, easy-to-implement auxiliary tool for preoperative EGFR mutation stratification to optimize EGFR-TKI therapy decisions.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: In patients with acute pulmonary embolism (PE), major bleeding (MB) is the counterbalance for anticoagulant and thrombolytic treatment. We aimed to assess independent predictors of MB, evaluate the performance of available bleeding risk scores, and identify bleeding-phenotypes in patients with acute PE from a prospective, multicentre study. METHODS: The primary outcome was MB defined according to ISTH criteria occurring during 30-day follow-up. MBs were classified as early (<7 days) and late (≥7 days) based on days from PE diagnosis. RESULTS: Among 5213 patients with acute PE, 159 had MB (3.1%), 78 as early, and 81 as late events. MB occurred in 12.9% and 2.5% of patients treated versus not treated with thrombolysis. Active cancer, previous bleeding, dementia, anemia, syncope, and thrombolysis were independent predictors of early MB and of MB at 30 days; active cancer, previous bleeding and anemia were independent predictors of late MB.Four bleeding-phenotypes were identified; phenotype#1=previous VTE/estrogen users, #2=unprovoked PE, #3=cancer patients, #4=fragile patients with comorbidities. The risk of MB was lower in the previous VTE (#1) bleeding-phenotype in comparison to the others, with a trend toward increased risk from phenotype #1 to #4. Performance of phenotypes to predict MB at 30-days was similar to that of PE-SARD, BACS and VTE-Bleed. CONCLUSIONS: In patients with acute PE, risk factors for early and late MB within 30 days differ. Compared to stratification strategies that solely based on bleeding predictors, phenotyping appears to offer similar accuracy in identifying patients at risk for MB.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Hemoptysis is a challenging respiratory emergency ranging from mild symptoms to life-threatening conditions. Early identification of patients at risk for hemodynamic collapse and massive bleeding is crucial for guiding admission to respiratory wards or intensive care units. This study aimed to assess the prognostic performance of the shock index (SI), modified shock index (MSI), and age shock index (ASI) in predicting 30-day mortality and life-threatening hemoptysis (LTH). METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study including adult patients admitted to the ED with hemoptysis. SI, MSI, and ASI were calculated using initial vital signs. The primary outcome was 30-day mortality; the secondary outcome was LTH. To evaluate predictive performance, we performed multivariable logistic regression, receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis, continuous net reclassification improvement (NRI), integrated discrimination improvement (IDI), and Cox proportional hazards models. Exploratory LASSO regression was used only for preliminary screening of candidate variables. RESULTS: Among 592 patients, the 30-day mortality rate was 8.4%. All three indices demonstrated significant discrimination for mortality (AUCs: 0.854 for ASI, 0.836 for SI, 0.819 for MSI). ASI achieved the highest IDI (0.057) and NRI (0.943) improvement over the base model. In Cox regression, a 1-SD increase in the ASI was associated with a higher hazard of mortality (HR: 1.813; 95% CI: 1.449-2.268) and the highest model concordance (C-index: 0.870). Kaplan-Meier analysis confirmed significantly lower survival in high-risk groups (log-rank p < 0.001 for all indices). For the secondary outcome (LTH), simple hemodynamic indices (SI and MSI) outperformed ASI, which was not an independent predictor in multivariable analysis. CONCLUSIONS: Each index demonstrates a distinct prognostic strength in the management of hemoptysis. The ASI may have utility for initial triage risk assessment due to its association with 30-day mortality, whereas the MSI and the SI appear more reflective of acute hemodynamic crises such as LTH. These findings suggest that a tailored application of shock indices may contribute to improved risk stratification in hemoptysis management; however, this potential two-tiered approach warrants further prospective validation.

papers.abstract_en: Lung cancer remains the most common malignancy in Asia and is characterised by a substantial proportion of cases occurring in never-smokers, a feature that distinguishes the region from many Western populations. Only 20-25% of patients with newly diagnosed non‑small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) present with resectable disease. As precision oncology expands into earlier stages, understanding how global standards can be adapted to Asian healthcare systems is increasingly important. This expert consensus report summarises evidence-informed opinions and voting outcomes from 13 lung cancer specialists across 11 countries to identify regional priorities, practical implementation needs, and management strategies for early and locally advanced NSCLC. Experts supported annual low‑dose CT (LDCT) screening for high‑risk individuals, with adaptation of criteria to better capture Asia's substantial burden of never‑smokers and individuals with strong family history. Early diagnostic pathways emphasised rapid tissue acquisition and timely biomarker testing specifically EGFR, ALK, and PD‑L1 at initial diagnosis for both resectable and unresectable disease. Across resectable stage II-III disease, evidence from multiple Phase III trials consistently demonstrates that integrating immunotherapy with neoadjuvant or perioperative chemotherapy improves pathological response and event‑free survival, while maintaining surgical feasibility. Differences between regimens relate largely to timing, agent selection, and biomarker effects, and practical adoption in Asia varies according to diagnostic capacity and local resource availability. For unresectable stage III NSCLC, concurrent chemoradiotherapy followed by consolidation durvalumab remains standard, while recent data from the LAURA trial support consolidation osimertinib after CRT for EGFR-mutated disease, with a marked progression-free survival benefit (HR 0.16). Shared regional gaps include limited screening uptake, variable reimbursement for molecular testing and targeted therapies, and uneven access to multidisciplinary care. Collectively, the available evidence suggests that earlier biomarker testing, structured nodule management pathways, and broader access to perioperative and consolidation therapies can meaningfully improve outcomes in Asian populations. Strengthening MDT integration and harmonising diagnostic and therapeutic workflows across settings remain essential next steps.

papers.title_zh: 股静脉淤血指数（FVSI）能否在ESC/ERS 2022三分层模型基础上改善肺高压患者1年风险再分类：CODOVEIN研究事后分析
papers.title_en: Femoral venous stasis index improves risk classification in patients with pulmonary hypertension: a post-hoc analysis of the CODOVEIN study.
papers.authors: Croquette M, Bertoletti L, Jutant EM, Trihan JE
papers.affiliation_highlight: Vascular Medicine Department, Poitiers University Hospital, Poitiers, France.
papers.results: 全球NRI为0.736，事件组分量为0.333，非事件组分量为0.403；中间风险患者中1年事件率随FVSI分级升高（16.7%、43.5%、66.7%；p = 0.027）；按FVSI分组的生存差异显著（p < 0.001）。主要复合终点为1年 morbidity-mortality：PH特异治疗升级、右心衰住院或PH相关死亡。摘要未报告各组样本量、事件绝对数、NRI的CI或校正后的多因素结果。
papers.authors_conclusion: FVSI显著改善肺高压患者的1年风险分类，尤其在中间风险类别中；作为静脉淤血的简单无创标志物，FVSI可细化预后评估，值得在前瞻性多中心研究中评价。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：NRI 0.736未报告95%CI/P值，无法判断再分类增益的统计学稳定性；样本仅91例且为事后分析，事件数未给出，NRI在小样本中易高估。中间风险亚组事件率梯度的p=0.027来自预设阈值分组的事后亚组分析，属探索性；生存分析p<0.001未见按ESC/ERS分层校正或多因素调整，FVSI可能仅是右心功能/静脉压的替代指标而产生混杂。未见主要终点与次要终点的取舍问题，但摘要强调NRI增益的同时未报告其置信区间与模型判别指标（C指数）变化。

pico.p: CODOVEIN研究中确诊肺高压患者91例（62.2%为毛细血管前型PH）
pico.ic: 在ESC/ERS 2022三分层模型基础上加用按预设阈值（<0.18、0.18-0.45、>0.45）分级的FVSI进行风险再分类；对照为仅按ESC/ERS 2022标准分类

papers.reason: 影响肺高压患者（尤其ESC/ERS中间风险人群）的预后分层与随访/治疗升级决策思路，为超声无创静脉淤血指标的验证研究提供可参考的NRI评估框架与效应量基线；样本量小、事后设计限制其直接改变临床实践。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Pulmonary hypertension (PH) requires accurate risk stratification to guide management. Although current ESC/ERS three-strata model is widely used, most patients remain classified at intermediate risk, limiting clinical decision-making. The femoral venous stasis index (FVSI), a Doppler-derived marker of venous congestion, has been associated with elevated right atrial pressure. We evaluated whether FVSI improves 1-year prognostic classification beyond the ESC/ERS 2022 model. METHODS: This post hoc analysis used data from the CODOVEIN study, including patients with confirmed PH. The primary composite endpoint was 1-year morbidity-mortality: escalation of PH-specific therapy, hospitalization for right-heart failure, or PH-related death. Patients were classified using ESC/ERS 2022 criteria. FVSI was categorized using predefined thresholds (<0.18, 0.18-0.45, >0.45). Risk improvement was assessed using the Net Reclassification Index (NRI). Survival was analyzed with log-rank tests. RESULTS: Ninety-one patients were included (62.2% precapillary PH). The global NRI was 0.736, with event and non-event components of 0.333 and 0.403, respectively. Among intermediate-risk patients, 1-year event rates increased across FVSI categories (16.7%, 43.5%, 66.7%; p = 0.027). Survival differed significantly across FVSI-based subgroups (p < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: FVSI significantly improves 1-year risk classification in PH patients, particularly within the intermediate-risk category. As a simple, non-invasive marker of venous congestion, FVSI may refine prognostication and deserve evaluation in prospective multicenter studies.

papers.title_en: Association Between Eosinophils and Readmission in Patients with Eosinophil-Fluctuating AECOPD: A Multi-Threshold PWP-GT Analysis.
papers.authors: Gong Y, Zhang P, Sun H, Wang R
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Respiratory and Critical Care Medicine, The First Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University, Hefei, …
papers.results: EOS ≥ 300 cells/μL（HR = 0.767, 95% CI: 0.602-0.977, P = 0.032）与EOS% ≥ 3%（HR = 0.804, 95% CI: 0.671-0.965, P = 0.019）为再入院的独立保护因素；EOS ≥ 100 cells/μL（P = 0.070）、EOS ≥ 1%（P = 0.100）、EOS ≥ 2%（P = 0.094）、EOS ≥ 200 cells/μL（P = 0.189）与再入院无显著关联。按性别、急性加重史、机械 ventilation、合并症分层的亚组分析中EOS ≥ 300 cells/μL与EOS% ≥ 3%的保护作用一致；在年龄<65岁及使用吸入药物治疗的患者中保护作用更明显（亚组未给出具体HR/CI/P数值）
papers.authors_conclusion: EOS波动型AECOPD患者具有独特的预后特征。较高的嗜酸性粒细胞水平与较低的再入院风险相关。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足/矛盾点：①方法学部分声明的阈值为100、200、30 cells/μL与1%、2%、3%，但结果报告的是EOS ≥ 300 cells/μL（300未在方法阈值列表中出现，而30未在结果中出现），阈值设定前后不一致；②至少检验6个阈值且未提及多重比较校正，阳性结果存在阈值搜索/偶然阳性风险，阴性阈值（100、200、1%、2%）被弱化处理；③为单中心回顾性观察研究，混杂（如全身激素使用、急性加重严重度）未说明是否校正；④纳入时间止于2026年6月，超出当前合理随访窗口，时间范围存疑；⑤亚组'更明显'的表述无具体交互作用P值与效应量支撑。

pico.p: 安徽第二人民医院呼吸与危重症医学科2021年1月至2026年6月至少两次AECOPD住院的患者224例、1095次住院
pico.ic: 以本次住院时EOS水平按多个阈值（100、200、30 cells/μL及1%、2%、3%）分组，比较其与至下次住院时间（再入院）的关联；无干预

papers.reason: 为COPD急性加重后嗜酸性粒细胞指导的随访与再入院风险分层提供多阈值证据，同时提示单一阈值结论的不稳定性，供呼吸科制定EOS监测与出院随访策略时权衡。
papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: Although peripheral blood eosinophils (EOS) have been extensively studied as a biomarker for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), the association between EOS and COPD prognosis remains controversial. Our objective was to analyze the relationship between EOS and readmission in patients with EOS-fluctuating COPD. PATIENTS AND METHODS: This is a retrospective, single-center study of inpatients admitted to the Department of Respiratory and Critical Care Medicine at Anhui Second People's Hospital between January 2021 and June 2026 due to at least two acute exacerbations of COPD (AECOPD). Prentice-Williams-Peterson Gap Time (PWP-GT) models were established using EOS thresholds of 100cells/ μL, 200cells/ μL, 30cells/ μL, 1%, 2%, and 3%. The relationship between EOS levels at the time of the previous hospitalization and the time interval until the next hospitalization was analyzed. RESULTS: The study included 224 patients and 1095 hospitalizations. EOS ≥ 300 cells/ μL (HR = 0.767, 95% CI: 0.602-0.977, P = 0.032) and EOS% ≥ 3% (HR = 0.804, 95% CI: 0.671-0.965, P = 0.019) were independent protective factors against readmission. EOS ≥ 100 cells/μL (P = 0.070), EOS ≥ 1% (P = 0.100), EOS ≥ 2% (P = 0.094), and EOS ≥ 200 cells/μL (P = 0.189) were not significantly associated with readmission. The protective effects of EOS ≥ 300 cells/μL and EOS% ≥ 3% were consistent across subgroup analyses stratified by sex, history of acute exacerbations, mechanical ventilation, and comorbidities. The protective effect of EOS was more pronounced in patients aged <65 years and in those using inhaled pharmacotherapy. CONCLUSION: Patients with EOS-fluctuating AECOPD have a unique prognostic profile. Higher eosinophil levels were associated with a lower risk of rehospitalization.

papers.title_en: Inspiratory Muscle Training Plus Schroth Exercise Versus Schroth Exercise Alone on Respiratory Function in Idiopathic Scoliosis.
papers.authors: Zhu W, He Y
papers.affiliation_highlight: Wangjing Hospital, China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences,Beijing, 100102, China.
papers.results: 12周时IMT+Schroth组较单纯Schroth组改善更显著：FVC（79.1 vs 73.8% predicted；p=0.003）、FEV1（82.7 vs 76.5% predicted；p=0.001）、PImax（84.7 vs 68.4 cmH2O；p<0.001）、PEmax（89.3 vs 72.6 cmH2O；p<0.001）、6分钟步行距离（412 vs 385 m；p=0.018）；PImax与PEmax效应量大（Cohen's d分别为1.42和1.38）；Cobb角与躯干旋转角（ATR）组间差异无统计学意义。
papers.authors_conclusion: Adding inspiratory muscle training to Schroth exercise produces clinically meaningful and statistically significant gains in respiratory function and muscle strength beyond those achievable with Schroth exercise alone. These findings support incorporating structured IMT into conservative physiotherapy programmes for adolescents with idiopathic scoliosis.
papers.ai_note: 摘要未指明预设的主要终点与主要分析时间点，同时报告多项结局（FVC、FEV1、PImax、PEmax、6MWT、Cobb角、ATR）并择优呈现阳性项，属多重比较下的选择性强调风险；作者称'clinically meaningful'但未给出MCID或最小临床重要差值依据；单盲但未说明盲法对象（Cobb角/ATR为放射与体表测量，评估者是否设盲信息不足）；分配隐藏、样本量估算与随访（12周后是否维持）信息不足；组间Cobb角无差异说明获益限于呼吸功能而非畸形矫正，结论口径超出对脊柱本身的表述范围。

pico.p: 68名12-18岁青少年特发性脊柱侧弯患者（Cobb角20-45°），IMT+Schroth组n=34，单纯Schroth组n=34
pico.ic: 干预：Schroth运动（每周3次）+阈值吸气肌训练（30% PImax起始，每两周递增负荷）；对照：单纯Schroth运动；疗程均12周

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (AIS) is associated with significant restrictive ventilatory impairment attributable to thoracic cage deformity and reduced respiratory muscle strength. Schroth physiotherapeutic scoliosis-specific exercise is an established conservative intervention, yet its impact on inspiratory muscle strength remains limited when applied alone. OBJECTIVE: To compare the effects of combined inspiratory muscle training and Schroth exercise against Schroth exercise alone on respiratory function, respiratory muscle strength, exercise capacity, and spinal deformity indices in adolescents with idiopathic scoliosis. METHODS: A single-blind randomised controlled trial enrolled 68 adolescents (aged 12 to 18 years) with confirmed idiopathic scoliosis and Cobb angle between 20 and 45 degrees. Participants were allocated 1:1 to either a combined IMT plus Schroth group (n=34) or a Schroth-alone group (n=34). Both groups completed 12 weeks of supervised Schroth exercise three times per week; the IMT group additionally performed threshold inspiratory muscle training at 30% of maximal inspiratory pressure, with load progression every two weeks. Outcomes assessed at baseline, six weeks, and twelve weeks included spirometry (FVC, FEV1, FEV1/FVC), respiratory muscle strength (PImax, PEmax), six-minute walk test distance, SpO2, Cobb angle (radiographic), and angle of trunk rotation (scoliometer). Mixed-model repeated-measures ANOVA was used for primary analysis. RESULTS: At twelve weeks, the IMT plus Schroth group demonstrated significantly greater improvements in FVC (79.1 vs 73.8% predicted; p=0.003), FEV1 (82.7 vs 76.5% predicted; p=0.001), PImax (84.7 vs 68.4 cmH2O; p<0.001), and PEmax (89.3 vs 72.6 cmH2O; p<0.001) compared with the Schroth-alone group. Six-minute walk test distance also improved significantly more in the IMT group (412 vs 385 m; p=0.018). Effect sizes for PImax and PEmax were large (Cohen's d 1.42 and 1.38 respectively). No significant between-group differences in Cobb angle or angle of trunk rotation were observed. CONCLUSIONS: Adding inspiratory muscle training to Schroth exercise produces clinically meaningful and statistically significant gains in respiratory function and muscle strength beyond those achievable with Schroth exercise alone. These findings support incorporating structured IMT into conservative physiotherapy programmes for adolescents with idiopathic scoliosis.

papers.authors: Caceres SM, Barboa C, Vahling S, Strand M, Nick JA, Gross JE
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Medicine, National Jewish Health, Denver, CO, USA; Department of Pediatrics, University of North Carolina,…
papers.results: 2017–2024年呼吸道培养率显著下降：全国由50.3%降至30.2%，NJH由83.5%降至46.4%。调整模型中，NTM培养阳性优势比自2020至2024年逐年上升，全国每年增加4.2%，NJH每年增加11.4%。趋势描述为CFTRm扩展前培养者NTM阳性更高、2020–2021年下降、至2024年回升；NJH培养者中NTM阳性率始终高于全国，但患者层面阳性率与美国全国水平接近。摘要未报告置信区间或P值。
papers.authors_conclusion: These findings suggest that CFTRm use decreased NTM culture surveillance, but NTM positivity is increasing. The concordance between national and referral-center data highlights the importance of reprioritizing NTM surveillance among pwCF taking CFTRm.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：主要结论所依赖的OR年增幅（4.2%、11.4%）未给出95%CI或P值，无法判断统计学显著性；摘要称'NTM positivity is stable to increasing'与'increasing annually'口径不完全一致。存在监测偏倚风险——培养率本身大幅下降（分母行为改变），阳性率上升可能反映培养指征向高危患者集中而非真实发病率上升，作者未讨论该混杂。观察性趋势数据无法证明CFTRm对NTM的因果作用，'CFTRm use decreased NTM culture surveillance'为推断性表述而非本研究直接检验的假设。此外为非肿瘤性呼吸病研究，与胸部肿瘤/胸外科核心业务关联有限。

papers.abstract_en: Nontuberculous mycobacteria (NTM) are respiratory pathogens associated with poor clinical outcomes in people with cystic fibrosis (pwCF). CFTR modulator therapy (CFTRm), particularly elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor (ETI), has dramatically improved outcomes in pwCF and is associated with reductions in Pseudomonas aeruginosa and methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus. However, impact on NTM remains unclear. We conducted parallel retrospective analyses of NTM trends among pwCF from 2017-2024 using CF Foundation Patient Registry (CFFPR) Annual Reports and surveillance data from National Jewish Health (NJH) Adult CF Program. Annual surveillance rates and NTM culture positivity were evaluated. For NJH longitudinal data (2020-2025), a generalized linear mixed model was used to assess NTM positivity trends, including a random intercept for subjects to account for repeated measures and intermittent missing cultures. From 2017-2024, U.S. and NJH NTM epidemiology showed parallel trends: higher NTM positivity among pwCF with cultures before CFTRm expansion and a decline in years 2020-2021, with increased rates by 2024. NJH consistently reported higher NTM positivity among cultured pwCF, yet patient-level NTM positivity aligned closely with U.S. rates. During the study, respiratory cultures substantially decreased, from 50.3% to 30.2% nationally and from 83.5% to 46.4% at NJH. NTM positivity is stable to increasing. In adjusted models, odds of NTM positivity increased annually by 4.2% nationally and 11.4% at NJH from 2020 to 2024. These findings suggest that CFTRm use decreased NTM culture surveillance, but NTM positivity is increasing. The concordance between national and referral-center data highlights the importance of reprioritizing NTM surveillance among pwCF taking CFTRm.

papers.title_zh: 基于胸部CT潜在类别分析识别IgG4相关病胸部受累五种影像亚型并比较其临床特征、影像转归与复发风险
papers.title_en: Imaging Subphenotypes of Thoracic Involvement in IgG4-Related Disease: A Latent Class Analysis.
papers.authors: Liu X, Zhou J, Nie Y, Peng L, Zhou J, Zhang L, Fei Y, Zhang W et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Radiology, Peking Union Medical College Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences & Peking Union Medic…
papers.results: 231例中支气管血管束增厚最常见（56.7%）。LCA分出5个亚型：BVB-LN 38.5%、结节型13.9%、间质型13.0%、纵隔-胸膜型18.6%、混合型16.0%；各亚型在年龄、呼吸症状、胸外受累与免疫学谱上存在差异。间质型影像改善率最低（41.7%）、进展率最高（37.5%）。复发风险：混合型 HR 3.821（95%CI 1.336-10.923，P=0.012）、BVB-LN型 HR 2.804（95%CI 1.062-7.399，P=0.037）独立相关于更高复发风险；糖皮质激素联合免疫抑制剂治疗相关于更低复发风险 HR 0.405（95%CI 0.223-0.735，P=0.003）。
papers.authors_conclusion: In this single-center cohort, LCA identified five thoracic imaging subphenotypes of IgG4-RD with specific clinical profiles, radiologic outcomes, and relapse risk. External validation is required before broader generalization or adoption as a standard classification framework.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足/疑点：回顾性单中心、摘要未报告LCA类别数如何确定（拟合指标、类别选择依据）、未给出各亚型复发的事件数与随访时长，也未说明Cox模型中亚型比较的参考组；亚型HR的CI很宽（混合型1.336-10.923）提示事件数有限。间质型影像改善率/进展率仅报百分比，无CI、P及分母例数。治疗与复发的关联来自非随机分配，存在适应证混杂（病情更重者更可能接受联合治疗），HR 0.405不应作疗效因果解读。摘要未报告外部验证，亚型分类的可推广性与可重复性未确立。

pico.p: 单中心回顾性纳入的IgG4相关病且CT证实胸部受累患者231例
pico.ic: 以LCA得到的5种影像亚型（BVB-LN、结节型、间质型、纵隔-胸膜型、混合型）相互比较临床/血清学特征、影像转归与无复发生存；治疗因素比较糖皮质激素联合免疫抑制剂治疗与其他治疗

papers.reason: 为IgG4相关病胸部受累提供一种可复核的CT影像分型框架，影响影像科与呼吸科对该病表型异质性的描述及复发高危患者的随访强度判断；同时其治疗-复发关联仅可用于假设生成，不可指导用药决策。
papers.abstract_en: RATIONALE AND OBJECTIVES: Thoracic manifestations of IgG4-related disease (IgG4-RD) are heterogeneous. We aimed to identify distinct imaging subphenotypes using latent class analysis (LCA) of chest computed tomography (CT) features and assess their associations with clinical characteristics, radiologic outcomes, and relapse risk. MATERIALS AND METHODS: We retrospectively included patients with IgG4-RD and CT-confirmed thoracic involvement. Baseline chest CT findings were independently assessed by two thoracic radiologists. LCA of binary CT features was performed to identify imaging subphenotypes. Clinical and serologic characteristics, extrathoracic involvement, radiologic outcomes, and relapse-free survival were compared across subphenotypes. Cox regression analyses were used to identify factors independently associated with relapse. RESULTS: Among 231 patients, bronchovascular bundle thickening was the most frequent CT finding (56.7%). LCA identified five imaging subphenotypes: bronchovascular bundle-lymph node (BVB-LN, 38.5%), nodular (13.9%), interstitial (13.0%), mediastinal-pleural (18.6%), and mixed (16.0%). These subphenotypes differed in age, respiratory symptoms, extrathoracic involvement, and immunologic profiles. The interstitial subphenotype had the lowest radiologic improvement rate (41.7%) and highest progression rate (37.5%). The mixed (hazard ratio [HR], 3.821; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.336-10.923; P = 0.012) and BVB-LN (HR, 2.804; 95% CI, 1.062-7.399; P = 0.037) subphenotypes were independently associated with higher relapse risk, whereas combined glucocorticoid and immunosuppressant therapy was associated with lower relapse risk (HR, 0.405; 95% CI, 0.223-0.735; P = 0.003). CONCLUSION: In this single-center cohort, LCA identified five thoracic imaging subphenotypes of IgG4-RD with specific clinical profiles, radiologic outcomes, and relapse risk. External validation is required before broader generalization or adoption as a standard classification framework.

papers.authors: Mendoza MA, Tang A, Marchevsky AM, Yuen AD, Sankar K, Falk JA, Kaderi T, DiChiacchio L et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Division of Pulmonary and Critical Care Medicine, Cedars Sinai Medical Center, Los Angeles, CA, USA.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Silicosis associated with progressive massive fibrosis (PMF) is a major cause of end-stage lung disease among workers in the artificial stone industry. Patients with PMF are increasingly referred for lung transplant (LTx) evaluation and there is emerging evidence of pulmonary hypertension (PH) in patients with advanced PMF. RESEARCH QUESTION: Among patients with PMF referred for lung transplantation, what is the incidence of PH and what are accompanying histopathologic pulmonary vascular aberrations? STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: Retrospective single-center cohort study of prospectively-enrolled participants, providing granular data on the invasive hemodynamic profile of patients with silicosis-associated PMF, histopathologic data on pulmonary vascular aberrations, and clinical data on post-transplant complications. Clinical and sociodemographic variables were collected. Explanted lungs from patients with silicosis-associated PMF underwent detailed pulmonary vascular histopathologic review and were descriptively compared with PAH explants. The incidence of primary graft dysfunction (PGD) was evaluated and descriptive analysis performed to provide associations of clinical features and PGD incidence. RESULTS: PH was present in over 95% of 21 patients with silicosis-associated PMF who underwent LTx, with a hemodynamic profile similar to patients transplanted for PAH. . Silicosis explants showed confluent silicotic nodules, extensive fibrosis and hyalinization, obscuration or obliteration of vascular structures, and perivascular fibrohistiocytic infiltrates with extrinsic narrowing. Classic PAH-type arteriolar muscular hypertrophy and plexiform arteriopathy were uncommon. In exploratory comparisons, patients who developed PGD had more frequent pretransplant right ventricular dysfunction (71% vs 21%; risk difference 0.50, 95% CI 0.06-0.75) and a lower median TAPSE/RVSP ratio (0.27 vs 0.39; Hedges' g -0.93, 95% CI -1.88 to 0.02) than in those without PGD. INTERPRETATION: These findings suggest that PH in advanced silicosis with PMF is very common and represents a distinct pulmonary vascular phenotype characterized by extensive fibrotic vascular obliteration rather than the classic arteriopathy seen in PAH.

papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVE: To systematically evaluate the prevalence, clinical characteristics, and clinical outcomes of mucus plugging across chronic respiratory diseases. METHODS: Two authors searched four databases for eligible studies. Prevalence of mucus plugging was pooled and shown as percentage with a 95% confidence intervals (CI). Differences in clinical characteristics were summarized using mean differences or odds ratios, with corresponding 95% CIs. Sensitivity analyses, subgroup analyses and meta-regression were conducted for heterogeneity assessments. Associations between mucus plugging and clinical outcomes were systematically evaluated. RESULTS: A total of 33 studies was included. Prevalence of mucus plugging in asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and cystic fibrosis reached 63% (95%CI 52%, 74%), 47% (95% CI 38%, 55%) and 63% (95% CI 46%, 81%) respectively. Mucus plugging was associated with higher eosinophil counts and FeNO, and lower FEV₁% and FEV₁/FVC in asthma, as well as higher smoking odds. In COPD, mucus plugging was associated with older age and lower BMI, FEV₁%, FVC% and FEV₁/FVC (all p < 0.05). Meta-regression suggested that eosinophil counts (p < 0.01), FeNO (p = 0.02) and FEV1% (p=0.04) contributed to heterogeneity in asthma, and inhaled corticosteroid (p < 0.01) and FEV1/FVC (p < 0.01) contributed to heterogeneity in COPD. Presence of mucus plugging was also associated with higher risk of acute exacerbation, mortality, prolonged hospital stays and increased hospitalization costs in patients with COPD. CONCLUSION: Mucus plugging is prevalent in chronic respiratory diseases and associated with distinct clinical characteristics and outcomes. Future research may focus on mucus plugging as a treatable trait to improve prognosis of these patients.

papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Pneumothorax is a common cause for hospital presentation. It can be divided into spontaneous and nonspontaneous subtypes depending on underlying mechanism. This review focuses on recent evidence, guidelines, and controversies relating to the assessment and management of spontaneous pneumothorax. RECENT FINDINGS: Advances in imaging and genetics have led to increasing recognition of structural, genetic, and hormone related causes of spontaneous pneumothorax. Many of these syndromes carry important extrapulmonary implications and require early diagnosis. Randomised data now support a conservative, symptom-guided approach in primary spontaneous pneumothorax. Persistent air leak in secondary spontaneous pneumothorax remains a challenging area especially in nonsurgical candidates, with available treatment options such as autologous blood patch therapy, pleurodesis, and endobronchial valves supported by limited high-quality evidence, leaving clinicians with little guidance in this heterogenous population. SUMMARY: Management of spontaneous pneumothorax has moved from a size-based interventional model towards a more individualised, symptom-guided approach. The future of pneumothorax care should focus on cost-effective screening for underlying aetiologies in PSP, understanding patient perspectives and priorities, improving understanding of disease mechanisms across different subgroups, and more robust evidence to guide optimal treatment strategies.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Pulmonary hypertension (pH) is a recognized complication of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), in which right ventricular (RV) dysfunction is associated with worse outcomes. The prognostic value of the pulmonary artery pulsatility index (PAPi), a load-dependent surrogate of RV performance, remains unclear in COPD. METHOD: We performed a single-center retrospective cohort study of patients with COPD who underwent right heart catheterization (RHC) between January 2018 and December 2023. The primary outcome was a composite of all-cause mortality and heart failure hospitalizations. Data were stratified into PAPi tertiles, and outcomes were compared using Cox proportional hazards models, adjusted for demographics, comorbidities, and surrogates of COPD and pH severity. RESULTS: Among 224 patients, 50% were female, 75% African American, and 81% had pH. Median (ranges) PAPi values in the high, intermediate, and low tertiles were 8.1 (4.7-90), 3 (2.3-4.7), and 1.6 (0.5-2.3), respectively. Patients with low PAPi had higher mean and diastolic pulmonary artery pressures, as well as left- and right-sided filling pressures on RHC. On echocardiography, those with low PAPi had lower left ventricular systolic function and more RV strain. Compared with high PAPi, low PAPi was associated with higher risk of the composite outcome (unadjusted model: hazard ratio [HR]=2.36 [95% CI 1.34-4.17], p-value=0.003; adjusted model: HR=2.65 [95% CI 1.42-4.92]; p-value=0.002). CONCLUSION: Lower PAPi may identify patients with COPD at increased risk of adverse outcomes. Future studies are needed to validate our study findings in different COPD cohorts and explore optimal PAPi cutoffs.

papers.abstract_en: Andes virus (ANDV) causes hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS), with rare outbreaks involving person-to-person transmission. A human ANDV isolate from one such outbreak and a rodent isolate from the same region differ in lethality in Syrian golden hamsters. Genomic analysis revealed 25 nonsynonymous substitutions, including one leading to a T641I change in the human ANDV glycoprotein precursor near its cleavage site. Although the isolates differed in growth kinetics, strand-specific RT-qPCR did not support major differences in viral RNA synthesis, whereas virion release was delayed in the case of the human isolate. In human cell expression systems, a single I641T substitution in the human ANDV glycoprotein resulted in decreased Golgi retention and faster release of virion-like particles relative to wild-type glycoprotein. Since ANDV egress takes place at the Golgi, the T641I change present in the human ANDV isolate may represent a human adaptive mutation influencing glycoprotein trafficking and virus particle release.

papers.abstract_en: Phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase (PHGDH) participates in serine biosynthesis and has been implicated in cancer metabolism. However, how PHGDH expression is controlled in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and whether this regulation is linked to tumor behavior remain unclear. We examined PHGDH expression in paired NSCLC and adjacent non-tumor (ANT) tissues and assessed its association with patient survival. In A549 and H1299 cells, PHGDH and Sp1 were manipulated to evaluate their effects on cell growth, migration, invasion, sphere formation, and metabolic parameters. Serine supplementation and PHGDH inhibitors were used to further examine PHGDH-associated sphere formation. The interaction between Sp1 and the PHGDH promoter was investigated using DNA pull-down, chromatin immunoprecipitation, and luciferase reporter assays, and functional effects were further evaluated in xenograft models. PHGDH expression was higher in NSCLC tissues than in ANT tissues, and high PHGDH expression was associated with shorter overall survival. PHGDH modulation altered cell proliferation, migration, invasion, and sphere formation. PHGDH overexpression increased intracellular serine and glycine contents and relative NADPH levels and enhanced FCCP-stimulated OCR and oligomycin-stimulated ECAR. PHGDH knockdown produced the opposite changes and increased ROS levels. l-serine supplementation increased sphere formation after PHGDH knockdown, whereas NCT-503 and CBR-5884 attenuated the increase caused by PHGDH overexpression. Sp1 bound to the PHGDH promoter, and its expression was positively correlated with PHGDH in clinical specimens. Altering Sp1 expression resulted in parallel changes in PHGDH and the associated cellular phenotypes, whereas PHGDH knockdown weakened the effects of Sp1 overexpression both in vitro and in xenograft tumors. These findings indicate that PHGDH is transcriptionally regulated by Sp1 and contributes to tumor growth and stemness-related features in NSCLC.

Domiciliary fractional exhaled nitric oxide (FeNO) measurements offer real-time inflammatory tracking. OBJECTIVE: To explore asthma clinical phenotypes and prognosis using FeNO trajectories. METHODS: In this 24-week prospective cohort study, 89 participants recorded daily FeNO and completed weekly online questionnaires. ICS dose adjustments, including step down decisions, followed GINA stepwise approach based on clinical stability. Spirometry, blood eosinophil counts, exacerbation rates, and corticosteroid requirements were assessed at baseline and during stable-phase control. Patients were classified into three phenotypes based on baseline and stable‑phase FeNO using the 50 ppb threshold (ATS guideline) and a ≥ 20% reduction criterion. Clustering analysis validated the classification. RESULTS: Three phenotypes were identified: (1) Low Group (n = 34): Sustained FeNO < 50 ppb (median: baseline 26.75 (17.33-32.04) ppb, stable-phase 18.05 (13.09-21.93) ppb). (2) Decrease Group (n = 31): Baseline FeNO ≥ 50 ppb (median: baseline 73.70 (62.67-96.00) ppb) with ≥ 20% reduction to stable-phase values < 50 ppb (median: 27.06 (22.77-32.70) ppb). (3) High Group (n = 24): Persistent FeNO ≥ 50 ppb (median: baseline 104.30 (79.00-128.00) ppb, stable-phase 68.48 (59.22-76.98) ppb).The High group had higher late-onset asthma (87.5%) and rhinosinusitis (62.5%) rates, required higher ICS doses (600 vs. 400 µgBDPeq/day, P < 0.05), and showed minimal FEV1 improvement (ΔFEV1 +7.34%, P = 0.32) with FeNO rebound during ICS tapering. The Decrease Group exhibited the greatest FEV1 improvement (P < 0.05) and the lowest exacerbation rate (0.26/person-year). Overall, 95% of patients reached FeNO stability within 41.4 days. Baseline FeNO > 78 ppb combined with FEV₁/FVC > 75% predicted the High phenotype (AUC 0.89, 95% CI 0.79-0.98). CONCLUSION: Home‑based FeNO monitoring identifies three clinically distinct asthma phenotypes with different treatment responses and ICS tapering safety. The 41‑day stabilization window and prediction model provide an evidence‑based framework for personalized, biomarker‑guided asthma management.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Pulmonary fibrosis (PF) is a progressive interstitial lung disease driven in part by epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT), but the upstream epithelial regulators remain undefined, and conventional screens rarely separate causal drivers from bystanders. METHODS: We integrated interpretable machine learning (SHAP-interpreted LASSO across five transcriptomic cohorts), single-cell virtual gene knockout (VGKO), protein-protein docking with molecular dynamics, co-immunoprecipitation and surface plasmon resonance, a bleomycin mouse model, and loss-/gain-of-function studies in TGF-β1-stimulated BEAS-2B cells, complemented by AI-guided drug screening. RESULTS: SHAP nominated MT2A as a positively weighted predictor broadly expressed across multiple cell subpopulations, and in silico knockout nominated S100A8 as its leading candidate downstream target, yielding a directional MT2A→S100A8 hypothesis. Docking and molecular dynamics predicted a stable MT2A-S100A8 complex, co-immunoprecipitation recovered both proteins from the same complex in cells, and surface plasmon resonance measured direct binding with an apparent dissociation constant of 88 ± 20 nM. MT2A and S100A8 were co-upregulated in fibrotic mouse lung. In epithelial cells, MT2A knockdown reduced S100A8 and reversed the EMT signature, whereas overexpression amplified it. Reciprocal epistasis placed S100A8 downstream of MT2A as its obligate effector: re-expressing S100A8 restored EMT in MT2A-depleted cells, and silencing S100A8 abolished the pro-fibrotic effect of MT2A overexpression. AI screening nominated BRD-K54403101 as a candidate MT2A binder. CONCLUSION: We identify MT2A as broadly expressed across single-cell clusters and show that in bronchial epithelial cells MT2A sustains S100A8, which is necessary and sufficient to drive the EMT program. The experimentally defined MT2A-S100A8 axis is a tractable target in pulmonary fibrosis.

papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: To evaluate the diagnostic value of clinical and intravoxel incoherent motion (IVIM) parameters for differentiating large anterior mediastinal invasive masses (≥ 3 cm), particularly thymic epithelial tumors (TETs) and lymphomas. METHODS: This prospective study included 92 patients (mean age, 44.8 ± 15.5 years) with pathologically confirmed TETs (n = 52) or lymphomas (n = 40) who underwent routine MRI, diffusion-weighted imaging, and IVIM sequences. Quantitative parameters, including the apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC), true diffusion coefficient (D), pseudo-diffusion coefficient (D*), and perfusion fraction (f), were measured. Univariate and multivariate logistic regression analyses were used to construct predictive models. Diagnostic performance was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis, with area under the curve (AUC) compared by the DeLong test. Internal validation was performed using bootstrap resampling, and multicollinearity was assessed using variance inflation factors. RESULTS: Compared with TET, lymphoma was associated with younger age, higher female proportion, higher LDH, larger volume, more frequent pleural and/or lung invasion, and higher D * values (all p < 0.05). Age, sex, LDH level, lung and/or pleural infiltration, and f in the IVIM model were risk predictive factors for distinguishing lymphoma from TET. Among all models, the clinical MRI-IVM model achieved the highest diagnostic performance numerically (AUC = 0.946, 95% CI: 0.901-0.991); However, compared with the clinical MRI model (AUC = 0.929, 95% CI: 0.873-0.985), the increment brought by adding IVIM parameters was not significant (DeLong test, P = 0.316). Calibration analysis showed good consistency between predicted probabilities. The apparent AUC of Bootstrap's internal validation was 0.946, the estimation deviation was 0.017, and the standard error was 0.022, indicating limited optimism in the model's performance. CONCLUSIONS: The clinical-MRI-IVIM model had shown relatively good diagnostic performance in preoperative differentiation of large anterior mediastinal TETs and lymphoma. However, there is no statistical difference in the increment benefit generated by IVIM parameters in the composite model. Therefore, in order to elucidate the clinical efficacy of IVIM, further large-scale, prospective, and multi-center studies are necessary.

papers.abstract_en: Imaging-defined high-risk phenotypes may capture biologically aggressive disease states, but translating them into therapeutic hypotheses remains challenging. We developed ParetoRx, a radiogenomic imaging-informatics framework integrating computed tomography radiomics, pathway-level transcriptomic analysis, multiobjective Pareto optimization, and model-free Q-learning for non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Pretreatment CT data from 402 patients were used for model development and internal validation, with 110 patients forming a held-out external cohort. The final radiomics model achieved an external C-index of 0.707 (95% CI 0.627-0.783); high-risk patients had worse overall survival (HR 3.461, 95% CI 1.674-7.153), with minimal change after adjustment for histology (HR 3.444, 95% CI 1.662-7.137). Gene set enrichment and single-sample pathway analyses identified exploratory associations involving E2F targets, MYC targets V1, inflammatory response, and hypoxia, although no pathway met FDR < 0.05. LINCS L1000 perturbational profiles were evaluated using transcriptomic reversal, pathway specificity, and a feasibility-related proxy, with 4188 compounds retained in the common complete-case analysis. Multiobjective Pareto optimization was combined with three-split consensus ranking and sequential policy evaluation. TWS-119 showed consistent prioritization across all three splits (ranks 1, 3, and 4) and was Pareto-optimal in each split. In simulation-based evaluation, model-free Q-learning achieved higher terminal-goal attainment than myopic and static policies across all three splits, with improvements of approximately 6.2-13.3 percentage points over the myopic comparator. These findings support ParetoRx as an exploratory framework for biologically informed compound prioritization and computational sequential decision-making, while independent drug response and clinical validation remain necessary.

papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVE: Correct use of non-invasive ventilation (NIV) and positive airway pressure devices (CPAP/BiPAP) is essential for treatment effectiveness and patient adherence. This study aimed to evaluate the reliability, quality, and patient education-related characteristics of YouTube videos about CPAP, BiPAP, and NIV devices. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This cross-sectional content analysis evaluated YouTube videos related to CPAP, BiPAP, and NIV devices. A YouTube search was conducted between January 10 and February 10, 2026, using the keywords "CPAP tutorial," "BiPAP settings," and "non-invasive ventilation device." The first 50 results for each keyword were screened, and 73 videos met the inclusion criteria. Videos were categorized as individual or institutional uploads. Two independent experts evaluated the videos using DISCERN, the Journal of the American Medical Association (JAMA) benchmark criteria, the Global Quality Scale (GQS), and the Patient Education Materials Assessment Tool for Audiovisual Materials (PEMAT-A/V). Statistical analyses were performed using SPSS version 27. RESULTS: Among the 73 videos, 49.3% were uploaded by individual users and 50.7% by institutional sources. According to PEMAT-A/V, 60.3% of the videos demonstrated low levels of understandability and actionability. Median scores were GQS 4 (3-4), DISCERN 57 (49-64), and PEMAT-A/V 68 (63-74). Institutional videos had significantly higher subscriber counts, views, and GQS, DISCERN, and PEMAT-A/V scores. Video duration showed positive correlations with views, likes, and DISCERN scores. Inter-rater reliability was high for DISCERN and PEMAT-A/V but poor for JAMA; therefore, JAMA-related findings should be interpreted cautiously. CONCLUSION: YouTube videos related to CPAP, BiPAP, and NIV generally demonstrated moderate quality, but many provided limited patient education value. Content produced by institutional sources was associated with higher quality and better patient education metrics. These findings highlight the importance of developing more standardized and patient-centered online educational materials. TRIAL REGISTRATION: Not applicable.
